archiveTake: One of the archive's cleaner high-pressure sci-fi recommendations when you need both atmosphere and pressure.
spoilerFreeReview: I loved Derelict. It really keeps you on your toes with constant action without making you tired or confused. I especially like how it focuses on a small setting while constantly hinting at a much larger world beyond it.

It doesn't waste time dumping exposition on you and gets straight into the action. At the same time, it doesn't leave you wondering what everything is, because things are explained naturally as you go instead of through some long monologue about how this specific piece of tech killed someone's brother's wife's sister.

The atmosphere is also incredible. You really feel like you're in an underwater facility or an abandoned spaceship. The attention to detail in the sound design is one of my favorite parts, and it does an amazing job of immersing you in the experience.

This show is perfect for anyone who wants a proper sci-fi action audio drama while still getting characters you can genuinely become attached to. Even if sci-fi usually isn't your thing, Derelict is still worth trying. It's easily one of my favorite picks in the genre.
thoughts: This is the sort of show I reach for when someone wants a darker, immersive, cinematic pick.
It doesn't try to charm the listener first with grandiose world-building exposition. It tries to pull them forward, and it usually works.

quote.text: Whatever we try to escape, we inevitably bring with us.
